name: com.dest-69.advanced-popup-system
description:
Advanced Popup System - is a free flexible popup system.
You can add and change functionality depending on your needs.

samples.description: On-demand popup loading — lazy load, preload-at-boot, and pooled spawns, all draggable. Requires the Addressables package.
One popup per easing curve, each caching its own SlideSettings. Requires the Addressables package.
Popups animated with per-instance DOTween settings. Requires DOTween and the Addressables package.
Stress test of many simultaneous show/hide operations on pooled popups. Requires the Addressables package.
